children: XTI Aerospace announced preliminary third-quarter 2026 revenue of $35.3 million, in line with its full-year revenue outlook of $125 million to $130 million. The unaudited figure is based on currently available information and remains subject to the company’s quarter-end closing procedures and review. The company said demand for enterprise drone solutions continued across several markets.
The company’s 2026 revenue outlook remains $125 million to $130 million.
Management cited continued demand for enterprise drone solutions and expanded product offerings.
Demand was led by customers in public safety, government, energy, infrastructure, agriculture and commercial markets.
The company reported progress in reducing corporate overhead and lowering cash burn during the quarter.
XTI said it is working to address near-term liquidity needs, including restructuring acquisition-related notes.

title: XTI Aerospace Reports Preliminary Q3 Revenue of $35.3 Million
